title: 🎬 BIRTHDAY OF ANNIE ROSE — A New Dawn of Grace 🌤️
paragraphs: 🎬 BIRTHDAY OF ANNIE ROSE — A New Dawn of Grace 🌤️

Today isn’t just another candle on the cake —
it’s the light of Heaven whispering, “You’re still part of My story.” ✨

Every sunrise since day one has carried His promise.
Every breath is proof that grace never stops unfolding. 💖

🎂 Here’s to another year of faith, purpose, and radiant beginnings.
Let your light shine — the world needs your glow. 🌷
📖 “Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the Lord rises upon you.” — Isaiah 60 : 1
